statement: ∀ n U B : ℕ, let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; let coeff := fun (v : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) => ∑ a ∈ m.divisors.filter (fun a => U < a ∧ a ≤ B ∧ U < m / a), (∑ d ∈ a.divisors.filter (fun d => U < d), ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ)) * v (m / a); (((Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun m => coeff ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt m ≠ coeff w m)).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt n * Real.sqrt B * (Nat.log 2 n : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 限制 Type II 余因子为素数时发生权重变化的指标数
plain_statement.en: Count the Type II coefficients changed by restricting the cofactor to primes

brief.zh: 对任意 n、U、B，比较同一除数带内的冯·芒戈尔特权和素数对数权。发生变化时 m = a pᵏ，且 a ≤ B、k ≥ 2。按 a 和指数计数，对底数上界求和得 2√n √B ⌊log₂ n⌋。第一带取 B = ⌊n^(1/4)⌋。
brief.en: Use the same divisor band for both weights. Every changed index has the form a p^k with a ≤ B and k ≥ 2. Sum the base cutoffs over a to get 2√n √B ⌊log₂ n⌋. The first band uses B = ⌊n^(1/4)⌋.
